title: Circle defends USDC economics as stablecoin rivals court its partners with bigger cut
summary: Coinbase, Circle’s largest USDC partner, also backs Open USD, a rival network that passes reserve income to partners after a management fee.

title: Goldman, Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley see tokenization as a growth play, not a threat
summary: The largest banks in the world are eyeing new trading opportunities, speeding up payments and a role for advisers as tokenization takes root in Wall Street.

title: Citrini sees a tokenization boom. The harder question is who profits
summary: The influential research firm says real-world assets could finally give blockchains a clear role in finance. For investors, the next challenge is figuring out which companies, networks and protocols capture the revenue.

title: Polygon sees Coinme acquisition as entry to payments sector dominated by Visa, Stripe
summary: CEO Marc Boiron said the Coinme acquisition will help Polygon control customer relationships and capture revenue that previously went to payment intermediaries.

title: Banks could slow stablecoin growth by paying savers more, BIS paper finds
summary: A BIS working paper found a 1 basis point rise in U.S. bank deposit rates predicted slower stablecoin growth, cutting ten-week growth from 15% to 12%.
